Chapter 489 - 489 Solved The Function Question; Second Authors!

Chapter 489 - 489 Solved the Function Question; Second Authors!

489 Solved the Function Question; Second Authors!

Lin Fan carried the groceries and chatted with Su Ningjing as they walked toward the Washington Palace.

Just as he was about to open the door…

The big yellow dog that had been lying inside suddenly barked.

“Who is it? Who is it?”

When the door was completely opened and the big yellow dog saw that it was Su Ningjing, it wagged its tail and rushed up quickly.

As for Lin Fan, who was standing at the side, it was glaring at him like a tiger eyeing its prey. It kept whining as if it wanted to chase Lin Fan out.

“Big Yellow, don’t be fierce to Lin Fan!” Su Ningjing scolded.”

However, Big Yellow did not budge. It continued to bare its teeth at Lin Fan.

After all, it did not understand Su Ningjing’s words at all.

Lin Fan laughed, “Big Yellow, do you still remember me? I’m your mistress’ boyfriend! I even celebrated your birthday last time!”

After Big Yellow heard Lin Fan’s words, it stopped baring its teeth.

Its entire dog face was a little stunned.

That was because it understood Lin Fan’s words completely.

Even it found it unbelievable.

After a while, Big Yellow finally let out a cry.

“You are also a dog?”

Lin Fan’s lips twitched. He understood that he shouldn’t reason with dogs.

Therefore, he simply ignored it.

However…

Big Yellow barked at Lin Fan again.

“Are you really a dog?

“Isn’t that so?”

Lin Fan was speechless.

The old lady who was originally in the room slowly walked out when she heard the voice. She said kindly, “Lin Fan, you’re here?”

“Grandma, you look much better recently. You even have a lot more black hair,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Fan was not just spouting nonsense.

He had the Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience. With just a glance, he could observe the condition of the old lady’s body.

Now, the old lady’s body was indeed very healthy.

“Thanks to the tea leaves you sent me, I always feel very relaxed after drinking them.”

Obviously, she was talking about Spirit Tea.

Then, Lin Fan accompanied Grandma and Su Ningjing. They started chatting.

When the sun set, delicious food was served on the table.

At this moment, the door was slowly pushed open.

Ah Mei walked in with her school bag. She could not help but exclaim, “How fragrant!”

When she saw Lin Fan, she jogged over and shouted happily, “Brother Lin!”

As she spoke, she threw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace.

After leaving the mountains for a few months, Ah Mei’s skin was much fairer than before.

Her pair of big blinking eyes made her look like a lively little fairy.

“Sis, go wash your hands first and get ready to eat!” Su Ningjing said.

“Alright!” Ah Mei replied.

In the past, whenever Grandma, Su Ningjing, and Sis ate, they always wanted Lin Fan to eat first.

However, after Lin Fan’s repeated reminders, they could finally eat together.

The four of them enjoyed the meal.

Lin Fan stayed in the Washington Palace until 9 PM before driving the Cullinan toward the Coiling Dragon Villa.

After taking a cold shower, he lay down on the soft bed and fell asleep comfortably.

…

The night passed in the blink of an eye.

When Lin Fan opened his eyes, a ray of sunlight had already fallen on the windowsill.

He glanced at his phone.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 37,893,200 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he casually said, “Sign in!”

[Ding! You have successfully signed in. Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

Lin Fan chose to ignore all of this.

He lay on the bed for a while before getting up to wash up and eat breakfast.

Then, he drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University.

Ever since the report on Riemann’s Hypothesis, Lin Fan had been taking leave.

Counting the time, it had been a few days.

Logically speaking, most of the troublesome professors and reporters should have left.

Since that was the case, he naturally went to school.

After all, Lin Fan was also a professor at Jiangbei University and had a few students under him.

When Lin Fan drove into Jiangbei University, he could still see his own banner.

[Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for successfully solving Riemann’s Hypothesis!]

…

Lin Fan merely glanced at it casually and did not take it to heart.

Then, he walked straight to the office.

At this moment…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others were lying on the table and studying silently.

At that moment, Lil White, who was lying on Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder, squinting its eyes as if it was about to fall asleep, let out a loud cry.

Then, it jumped down and rubbed against Lin Fan’s feet.

“Master, you’re finally here.

“I missed you so much.

“Master, can you give me something delicious?”

Lin Fan smiled and patted the cat’s head. He tore open a bag of premium beef cat food and placed it in front of it.

Hao Zhiwu felt the weight on his shoulder lighten and immediately realized something. He said excitedly, “Professor Lin, you’re here! The Riemann Hypothesis report you gave in the auditorium was so cool!”

Lin Fan said strangely, “You guys didn’t go, right?”

After all, when he entered the venue that day, he deliberately looked at the audience and did not see his students.

“We heard about it from many people!” Hao Zhiwu said righteously.

Then, he picked up another journal and said a little embarrassed, “Professor Lin, if our names are listed as the second authors of Annual Mathematics like this… Isn’t it inappropriate?”

Even though he said that, his entire face was filled with smiles.

One had to know…

Annual Mathematics was the top mathematics journal!

In this world, how many names could appear here?

Not to mention, he was a student in the biology department.

This was definitely an honor, a great honor!

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Xu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others heard the conversation between the two people. They raised their heads one after another, and their faces were also full of excitement.

Lin Fan said, “Didn’t I ask you guys to solve a function question last time?”

“Yeah.” Hao Zhiwu nodded.

“Riemann’s Hypothesis is also a function problem, so it’s normal for your names to appear as the second author,” Lin Fan said.

After all, his mission was to get his students to solve math problems, which was how he got the answer to Riemann’s Hypothesis.

After Hao Zhiwu heard Lin Fan’s words, he was at a loss.

They solved a function problem, and Riemann’s Hypothesis was also a function problem, so their names could appear as the second authors?

However, the function question they answered was a very simple one!

What did this have to do with Riemann’s Hypothesis?
